description: Query intents drafted 2026-08-06, BEFORE the cards they will match (R1). Each row records the player-side phrasing, the intent behind it, and `topic_hint` -- the game entity a card must cover. `ban_verbatim` lists phrases the query is checked not to contain, so a card titled with one of them cannot be matched by echo. `expect_section` / `expect_topic` stay empty until the cards exist and the maintainer signs off; the file is not a scoring fixture until then.
